abstract: [SYNTHETIC TEST DOCUMENT] Procedure for verifying a reported acute diarrhoeal illness cluster: contact the reporting facilities, compare the counts with the expected seasonal level, and review the case line list for shared exposures. This document is fictional and exists only to test software.

excerpts.text: Step 1: contact the facilities that reported the acute diarrhoeal illness cases and check the number of cases, the dates of onset and the locations.
Step 2: compare the observed counts with the expected seasonal level for the block before deciding that an unusual increase has occurred.
Step 3: Ask about the household water source and recent community gatherings. Record the answers in the line list.
